existing_features: Multi-tenant architecture with kommune-level isolation
Authentication via ID-porten (Norwegian digital identity)
Role-based access control (RBAC) with capability-based guards
Listing/facility management with availability calendar
Booking system with recurring booking support
GDPR consent management and data subject request handling
Multi-channel notification system (in-app, email, SMS, push)
Real-time WebSocket updates for availability and notifications
Audit logging for all state mutations
Enterprise SDK with 30+ services and React Query hooks
Norwegian Design System facade (@xala/ds) with theme switching
Internationalization (Norwegian/English) via @xala/i18n
Discount code management
Dashboard with KPI reporting
Integration framework for third-party services
GraphQL API via Mercurius
Health checks and monitoring endpoints
Backoffice admin portal with comprehensive management features
User portal (minside) for citizen self-service
Public web app for listing discovery and booking initiation
target_audience: Norwegian municipal administrators (kommune staff) who manage public resource bookings, listings, and citizen services
